name: ai-ready
description: Audit AI-agent readiness, apply reviewed guidance improvements, and run unattended maker/checker loops (loop-run/build/lessons) in Codex. v0.8.7+: inject_lazy_load_index drops auto-table rows whose document is already linked from the user section — the root CLAUDE.md is always-loaded, so a doc listed in both the hand-written and the generated table costs its duplicate every session (12 rows / ~1,558 chars in one repo). Link targets are compared with trailing slashes normalized, only a row whose every target is already covered is dropped, and when all detected docs are covered the auto block renders a one-line note instead of an empty table — automating what previously needed hand-maintained config.override_hardcoded entries. v0.8.8+: the root `## 모듈 맵` stub listing length is config-driven — `module_map.root_stub_limit` (default 10, unchanged); 0 keeps only the catalog link and drops the per-module excerpt. The root doc is always-loaded and each module's one-line summary already lives in its own CLAUDE.md (auto-loaded when that module is opened), so the excerpt is duplicate context in repos that link enough paths elsewhere (~1,800 chars in one repo). Because audit's "root doc references 3+ module/doc paths" rule counts that listing as a reference source in some repos, the default is unchanged and setting 0 prints a notice instead of silently losing points. Bad values (negative, bool, non-int) fall back to the default rather than breaking generation. v0.8.9+: the root-size rule and the trigger table are re-aimed at always-loaded cost. Rule 2.1 measures the root CLAUDE.md in **bytes** (<=8,000 full, <=12,000 partial) instead of lines — a Korean markdown root packs a whole table row or paragraph into one line, so a real 46-line root doc weighing 12,029 bytes (one bullet alone 2,002 chars) took full marks under the old <=200-line rule while it kept growing; bytes weight Hangul 3:1 against ASCII, closer to token share. The evidence string carries both bytes and lines (kept even on a 0-point verdict) so audit history shows the trend. Repos that passed the line rule may now score lower — that break in the trend line is the intended correction, not a regression. inject_lazy_load_index folds "the filename IS the trigger" documents (COMMANDS/NAMING/TESTING/ARCHITECTURE/ANTIPATTERNS/INDEX) out of the auto table into one link line: 0.8.7 removed only *duplicate* rows, leaving rows that were not duplicates yet told the reader nothing a directory listing does not. The links stay on that line, so rule 1.2's path-reference count is unaffected — and that rule saturates at 3 references anyway, so a long table earns no points while costing context every session. --json facts gain `self_evident` so the AI maintenance path splits rows the same way the writer does.

interface.shortDescription: Audit and safely improve AI-agent guidance.
interface.longDescription: Assess a repository's AI-agent readiness, prepare reviewed guidance improvements, and check documentation freshness without Claude-only hooks.
